src: same-color diagonal marker pair s and other-color marker/control pixels on s.segment
path: connect s by its 45-degree diagonal segment; each control pixel on that segment casts the perpendicular 45-degree diagonal to both grid edges
trajectory: paint s.color along the segment and each control pixel's color along its full perpendicular diagonal
transform: preserve control pixels on the primary segment and keep all off-path foreground markers unchanged
multi_step: select the unique same-color diagonal pair whose segment contains the most other-color markers, paint that segment, then emit perpendicular diagonals from the preserved markers
